semantics.resultBoundary: A script result is a handoff object and must snapshot producer arrays before the async workflow consumer can retain it.
semantics.variableConsumer: The orchestrator reads variableChanges to update planner variables and to build the persisted trace variable list.
semantics.sourceEffectConsumer: The orchestrator reads sourceEffectNames when building the persisted trace variable list.
semantics.bridgeConsumer: The orchestrator passes bridgeTraces to LegadoExecutionTrace, whose constructor owns a second snapshot.
semantics.scope: This contract closes the transient result boundary inside ISSUE-COMPAT-242; it does not claim runtime semantic compatibility.
